Characters: @bau is Grandpa Bau, the purple ankylosaurus with round glasses and white eyebrows; @chiqui is Chiqui, the orange baby triceratops with a yellow-spotted frill; @roro is Roro, the yellow baby T-rex with orange spots on the back (round head, no frill, no horns); @torong is Torong, the green baby brachiosaurus with light-green spots; @pio is Pio, the little sky-blue pteranodon with a yellow beak. Draw them exactly like their element images. On THE SAME sunny flat grass field in every scene, with one straight white chalk running track going from right to left, palm trees and the far volcano. All five friends stand in a row facing the viewer with big smiles; Chiqui wears an ORANGE ribbon medal, Roro a YELLOW ribbon medal, Torong a GREEN ribbon medal, Pio a SKY-BLUE ribbon medal (each a simple round medal on a ribbon around the neck). Grandpa Bau, Chiqui and Roro each wave ONE front paw, Pio waves one wing, Torong tilts the long neck and head to one side. SIZE RULE: Torong is MUCH TALLER than everyone else, with a very long neck, and Torong's head is high above all the other friends' heads; Pio is the smallest. Torong never touches the face with front legs. Torong has exactly FOUR legs (two front legs, two back legs) and all four feet always stay on the ground; Torong NEVER lifts or waves a front leg. When others wave, Torong says hi or goodbye by tilting the long neck and head to one side with a smile. Draw exactly one of each character, never duplicated (5 characters in total). Show every character's full body from head to feet, with empty space around them; nothing is cut off at the edges. Keep the characters in the middle of the frame. Match the art style, colors, textures and lighting of @village (style only, do not copy its layout). Soft 3D toy-like clay style, smooth rounded shapes, soft studio lighting, gentle pastel color palette, very simple and readable for toddlers, no text.
vid: Grandpa Bau, Chiqui, Roro and Pio wave at the viewer; Torong sways the long neck side to side with all four feet on the ground. ONLY these 5 characters are in this scene: Grandpa Bau, Chiqui, Roro, Torong, Pio; no other character, animal or creature appears at any time. Torong stays much taller than everyone with a long neck the whole time. Pio always keeps wide thin sky-blue pteranodon wings, a pointed crest on the head and a long yellow beak; Pio never turns into a round bird or a chick. Roro always keeps a round head with no frill and no horns. Torong keeps exactly four legs with all four feet on the ground the whole time; Torong never lifts or waves a front leg and never grows an extra leg; to wave, Torong sways the long neck and head gently. The camera stays still: no zoom and no camera move; every character stays fully inside the frame from start to end. Do NOT add any baby, child, twin, copy, parent, or smaller or bigger version of any character. One continuous shot with no cuts and no scene changes. Keep every character exactly as in the start image and keep the soft 3D clay style unchanged. No new characters appear. Gentle, smooth motion.
